title: Cable Cars and Ski Lifts (lifts builder)
layout_order: hint (bold, top) | 1. What kind of lift? Cable car / Chair lift (ski lift) | 2. Click the stations on the ground: Undo last point, Start over, Look from above | plan line | 3. Build it: Build, progress bar | status line. The pen in the world: markers Bottom station / Bend / Top station and the preview.

controls.name: menu
controls.label: Wolf World > Build & Land > Cable Cars and Ski Lifts...
controls.action: Floater.Show wolf_lifts; off Wolf it says why and closes
source: <menu_item_call label="Cable Cars and Ski Lifts..." name="WolfWorldLifts">
std::string("Cable Cars and Ski Lifts is for Wolf Territories regions: the lifts run on the Wolf grid's scripts.")

controls.label: the step hint (Click on the ground where the BOTTOM station goes. / Now click where the TOP station goes ... / Getting your lift kit ready... / Working out where the towers go... / Press Build in the window ... / Building your lift ...)
source: return "Click on the ground where the BOTTOM station goes.";
return "Now click where the TOP station goes (to bend the line, click the bend first). Too far to click? Alt + drag moves the camera.";
return "Working out where the towers go...";
return "This line cannot be built yet - see the window. Drag a point to move it.";
return "Press Build in the window. Drag a point to move it; Ctrl+click on the line adds a bend.";
if (mBuilding) return "Building your lift - the parts are being put in place.";
std::string("Cable Cars and Ski Lifts works on Wolf Territories regions only.")

controls.label: 1. What kind of lift?  Cable car | Chair lift (ski lift)
controls.when: shown, not building (Cable car at first)
controls.tip: Cable car: a cabin that carries people between the two stations. Chair lift: chairs that go round and round, for skiers.
controls.action: changed(): the plan is asked for again (kind car / chair)
source: tool_tip="Cable car: a cabin that carries people between the two stations. Chair lift: chairs that go round and round, for skiers."

controls.name: step2
controls.label: 2. Click the stations on the ground
source: >2. Click the stations on the ground</text>

controls.label: Undo last point
controls.tip: Take the last point you clicked back (Backspace)
source: tool_tip="Take the last point you clicked back (Backspace)"
std::string("No points left - click where the bottom station goes.") : std::string("The last point was taken back.")

controls.label: Start over
controls.tip: Clear the drawing and click a new line
source: tool_tip="Clear the drawing and click a new line"
setStatus("Click on the ground where the bottom station goes.", false);

controls.label: Look from above
controls.tip: Turn the camera to look down on the line, so a click lands where you point
controls.action: lookFromAbove(): the camera looks down on the line (low enough for every click to find the ground); closing gives the camera back
source: tool_tip="Turn the camera to look down on the line, so a click lands where you point"

controls.label: the plan: n m long, n towers, n m up/down (and the kit's note), or why the line cannot be built
controls.when: two points, plan back from the kit
source: mPlanText = llformat("%s m long, %d tower%s", f[5].c_str(), towers, towers == 1 ? "" : "s");

controls.label: Build (large)
controls.when: a good plan, kit ready, not building
controls.tip: Make the stations, towers, cable and cabins or chairs here
source: tool_tip="Make the stations, towers, cable and cabins or chairs here"

controls.label: the status line (caution colour for errors): To take a lift down, touch one of its stations.; Building: n of m parts in place.; Built! ...; The lift was not built: ...; kit and region messages
source: >To take a lift down, touch one of its stations.</text>
setStatus(llformat("Building: %d of %d parts in place.", (S32)placed, (S32)total), false);
setStatus("Built! " + said + " To lay out another, click where its bottom station goes.", false);
setStatus("The lift was not built: " + said, true);

controls.name: alerts
controls.label: a lift that was not built, or a kit that could not be got, also says so in an OK alert
source: LLNotificationsUtil::add("GenericAlertOK", LLSD().with("MESSAGE", "The lift was not built.\n\n" + said));

controls.name: pen-click
controls.label: click on the ground: the bottom station, then bends, then the top station (markers Bottom station / Bend / Top station; at most MAX_POINTS)
source: "That is the most points one lift can have - drag a point to move it, or press Undo last point."
: "Click on the ground of the region you are in - a lift stays inside one region.";

controls.name: pen-drag
controls.label: drag a marker to move that point (a press is a click until it moves DRAG_START_PX)
source: if (surface(x, y, at)) f->moveClick(mDragPoint, at.mV[VX] + mGrabDX, at.mV[VY] + mGrabDY, false);
void WolfFloaterLifts::moveClick(S32 k, F32 x, F32 y, bool done)

controls.name: pen-ctrl
controls.label: Ctrl+click on a marker takes that point out (never the last two), Ctrl+click on the line puts a bend there
source: "A lift needs both its stations - drag them instead, or press Undo last point."
setStatus("A bend was put in - drag it where you want it.", false);
if (best_d > 6.f) { setStatus("Ctrl+click on the line to put a bend there.", true); return; }

controls.name: pen-keys
controls.label: Backspace takes the last point back; Escape drops a drag (The marker is back where it was.) or says what the pen is doing
source: if (f && key == KEY_BACKSPACE && mask == MASK_NONE) { f->undoPoint(); return true; }
if (mDrag == DRAG_MOVE) { dropDrag(); if (f) f->setStatus("The marker is back where it was.", false); return true; }
return "You are laying out a lift. Backspace takes the last point back; closing the window stops.";

controls.name: preview
controls.label: the plan drawn in the world: the cable, the towers and the stations' squares

controls.name: one-pen
controls.label: opening closes the Tunnels / Terraform window (one pen) and the Build window, and says so
source: setStatus("The Tunnels / Terraform window was closed: it draws with the same pen.", false);
setStatus("The Build window was closed so that your clicks lay out the lift.", false);
